workload.assumption_warning: 4 physical cores and the nominal2.8GHz come from a historical E8bds_v5 receipt, not a current official D8lds_v5 sustained-AVX receipt. SMT is not counted as doubling execution units.

existing_code.finding: ZMM dot_i8_x4 shares a query across four horizontal row dots, performs XOR bias and horizontal reductions, and uses64/32/16-coordinate chunks; its contract requires dimensions divisible by16. It does not execute the proposed packed K100 scan.
Existing x86 feature and environment dispatch checks avx2,avx512f,avx512vl,avx512vnni and falls back safely. New dispatch must preserve CPU/OS feature gating.
Dot callers enforce multiple-of16 lengths; arm64 has an existing signed-dot fallback. Neither path is a certified packed scan.
Existing list-major partition search reuses data across query chunks. Batching/code reuse itself is prior implementation, not a new mechanism.
E36 scalar native directed epilogue, signed correction, nonfinite fallback and floating-state restoration are the reviewed numerical contract.

fixed_tile.layout: Two16-row groups; each64-byte data register holds four unsigned-biased coordinates from each of16 rows; a repeated signed query dword feeds the dot. Bias is materialized once when encoding/updating data. No full distance matrix is stored.
fixed_tile.latency_note: Intel gives5-cycle VNNI latency and0.5-cycle isolated Xeon throughput; at least10 independent accumulators are needed to approach that isolated limit. Sixteen accumulators meet only this necessary dependency count.
fixed_tile.register_unknowns: Sixteen accumulators do not prove a spill-free fused schedule. Query scale/norm/radius/correction, metadata and epilogue temporaries cannot all remain resident at once. Reloads and moves must be counted from the actual assembly; no register tile sweep is permitted.

epilogue_contract.definitions: RD/RU are correctly rounded binary32 down/up; metadata scale positive, norm lower conservative, error radius upper conservative; U is an upper bound on the current kth exact source distance.
operations: Bq = RU(sqrt_RU(U)+query_error_upper), once per query/incumbent update
strict prune iff L>R; equality remains a candidate
epilogue_contract.machine_requirements: AVX512 embedded directed rounding with suppression of exceptions avoids per-pair fenv changes; integer conversion is exact in the supported domain. Preserve the E36 zero-dot treatment, source/metadata validation and fallback contract. FMA reassociation, heuristic epsilon, approximate reciprocal/sqrt and silent FTZ/DAZ changes are not permitted.
epilogue_contract.bound_not_irreducible: The35-operation sequence is the unchanged straightforward E36 translation, not a lower bound on every equivalent algorithm. Seeding the accumulator with the correction or moving the exact factor2 into query metadata may remove instructions, but requires a separately verified arithmetic/register contract; no gain from either is credited.

resource_bounds.llvm_model_trap: LLVM19.1.7 X86.td:1668-1676 maps both client and server to IceLakeModel. X86SchedIceLake.td:260,281 models ZMM FP add/multiply on only Port0, conflicting with Intel's Xeon0.5-cycle entries. The file declares CompleteModel=0 and says it is an iterative model. An uncorrected llvm-mca result is neither a decisive server lower bound nor a throughput measurement.
resource_bounds.disposition: No unconditional rejection or throughput acceptance follows. A compile-only artifact can reject an invalid/spilling implementation and expose instruction counts. Positive runtime evidence still needs one matched free target host measurement.

traffic_and_reuse.load_model_explanation: 50data64-byte loads+200query4-byte broadcasts+8metadata64-byte loads+32query scalar-field broadcasts. This is a fixed explicit loading model, not a hardware lower bound; actual code may reload more or reuse fields. A SoA scan can omit norm_upper from the hot pass, but its4-byte storage remains charged and seeds read it.
traffic_and_reuse.cache_levels: Eight-query register reuse reduces data+all-metadata input to14.5bytes/pair at the core. This does not force155.342GB/s DRAM traffic: outer4096-row blocks can retain475136bytes of code/metadata across all10000queries in L2/LLC. Query code/metadata and refinement activity compete for that cache; residency must be measured, not assumed.
unpriced_traffic: source refinement reads and cache eviction
traffic_and_reuse.schedule_constraint: Processing each4096-row block for allqueries preserves each query's fixed block order and exact threshold updates, but batches raw refinement at block boundaries. Retaining only one register tile and bounded candidate buffers is required; a full pairwise matrix is forbidden.

reserve_600_seconds.root_warning: This is only isolated16-lane square-root service. Seed dots, opposite-direction upper epilogue, selection, loop, broadcasts and scalar/fallback handling still count. It does not justify scalar26.2144B sqrt calls or assert a measured native seed cost.
reserve_600_seconds.seed_top10_selection: At least one treatment of each of4096 upper bounds/query; count26.2144B entries and all comparisons/moves. No sorting/selection time is assumed free.
reserve_600_seconds.development_transfer_warning: These are synthetic aggregate work extrapolations, not official-data estimates. All source distances include admitted seed IDs; no oracle work is subtracted. E38 had26 Fraction distance fallbacks and4 metadata fallbacks; E39 had1 Fraction distance fallback. A production exact fallback implementation and its rate remain unproved.
reserve_600_seconds.source_exact_cost: 100coordinate decodes, differences, wide squares and carry additions per admitted100D row, plus ordering and upper-threshold conversion. The native reference uses checked uint128; float64 accumulation is not silently substituted as exact. Interval ordering with exact ambiguity resolution would require its own proof and measured work count.
